I searched `src` for calls to `emit` from `@/lib/event-bus`, the function that publishes a domain event onto the in-process bus. These files call it:

- `src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts` emits `webhook.delivery_requested`.
- `src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts` emits `issue.overdue`.
- `src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts` emits `billing.plan_changed`.
- `src/server/services/usage-service.ts` emits `billing.limit_exceeded`.
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` emits the `issue.*` events.
- `src/server/services/member-service.ts` emits `member.role_changed` and `member.removed`.
- `src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts` emits `flag.toggled`.
- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts` emits `billing.limit_exceeded` and `billing.plan_changed`.
- `src/server/services/project-service.ts` emits `project.created`, `project.archived` and `project.restored`.
- `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts` emits `member.invited` and `member.joined`.
- `src/server/services/comment-service.ts` emits `comment.created` and `comment.deleted`.
- `src/server/services/organization-service.ts` emits `member.joined`.

These files don't publish, so I left them out:

- `event-registry.ts`, `search-service.ts`, `activity-service.ts`, `webhook-service.ts` and `notification-service.ts` only import `subscribe`.
- `auth-service.ts` mentions `emit` in a comment but never calls it. Registration publishes through `createOrganization` instead.
- `mention-textarea.tsx` has an unrelated local function named `emit`.
- The test files that import `emit` are not source files.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts, src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts
